title: Billing Standard: Monthly Vacant-Home Check Charge on In-Place Home Resale Files
content:
**Clause.** The standard vacant-home check charge for a month on an In-Place Home Resale file is the package's monthly vacant-home check fee, charged in full for every month or part month the home stands vacant and rounded half up to the cent. On a package whose monthly check fee is 0.00 no check charge arises.

**Definitions.**

- *Month charged* — the calendar month in progress on the day the check charge is worked out.
- *Day the home became vacant* — the date of the seller's accepted occupancy report on the file.
- *Package's monthly check fee* — the monthly vacant-home check fee of the package on the file, as the package's vacant-home care rates give it.
- *Rounding* — half up to the cent, once, on the final figure of the month's charge.

| Month | Charge |
|---|---|
| a full month the home stands vacant | the package's monthly check fee, in full |
| a part month the home stands vacant | the package's monthly check fee, in full |

## Worked figures (hypothetical file on a package whose monthly check fee is 45.00)

The seller's occupancy report recording the home vacant was accepted on 18 April. The charge for April, worked out during April, is 45.00; the charge for May, worked out during May, is 45.00. On a package whose monthly check fee is 0.00 the same months carry no charge.
